# Repository discoverability setup

Some GitHub repository settings are not stored in the Git tree. Apply these once in the repository settings after this PR is merged.

## About description

Suggested description:

> Safe database CLI for AI coding agents — schema knowledge graph, semantic context, SQL approvals & audit for MySQL, PostgreSQL, Oracle and ClickHouse.

## Topics

Recommended topics:

- `ai-agent`
- `database`
- `sql`
- `cli`
- `database-tools`
- `schema`
- `schema-graph`
- `jdbc`
- `mysql`
- `postgresql`
- `oracle`
- `clickhouse`
- `claude-code`
- `developer-tools`
- `data-governance`

Do not add `mcp` / `mcp-server` until the repository actually ships an MCP adapter.

## Discussions

Enable GitHub Discussions when there is capacity to answer usage questions and design discussions.

## Social preview

Use a 1280×640 image with a short message such as:

> SQLCLI — Database context & safe SQL execution for AI coding agents
>
> Schema Graph · Approval · Audit · Recovery

## Homepage

Once a public documentation site is available, set the repository Homepage field to that site. Until then, leave it blank rather than linking to an unrelated page.
